description: Defines classes and functions for managing data elements, including DataStore, DataElement, LinkedDataElement, and DataElementParser, with focus on memory management, serialization, and data searching within buffers.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a dynamically allocated buffer with methods for copying data, resizing, and accessing buffer properties.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data buffer with methods for reading, writing, searching, and manipulating binary data, supporting memory alignment and reallocation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Extends DataElement to support linked list of data buffers, allowing concatenated data management.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Provides read-only, sequential access to DataElement contents, with methods for searching and extracting data types.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into DataStore or DataElement buffers.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the data buffer.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type and endianness from the buffer at a given offset.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Writes a number of specified type and endianness into the buffer at a given offset.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number pattern within the buffer.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Copies a segment of the buffer into an external buffer.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Copies external buffer data into the buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the buffer pointer to the specified type's alignment.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the DataElement to an empty state.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement or LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns total size of linked data buffers.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the count of linked data buffers.
